name: Yu-Gi-Oh! API (YGOPRODeck)
tagline: Free Yu-Gi-Oh card database with images, sets, archetypes, and banlist data
description: YGOPRODeck provides a free public REST API for Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG/OCG card data: names, effects, attributes, types, ATK/DEF, set codes, rarity, banlist status, archetypes, and card images. Commonly used for deck builders, price trackers, and card search tools without requiring authentication for basic card queries.

auth.details: No API key required for public card database endpoints; requests are made directly to the open REST API.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API; rate limits apply (see rate_limits). No paid plans published for the core card database API.

rate_limits: Published guidance historically around 20 requests/second; confirm current limits on official docs. Excess may return HTTP 429.

example.response_snippet: {"data":[{"id":46986414,"name":"Dark Magician","type":"Normal Monster","frameType":"normal","desc":"The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.","atk":2500,"def":2100,"level":7,"race":"Spellcaster","attribute":"DARK",...}]}

use_cases: look up a Yu-Gi-Oh card by name or ID
fetch card images for a deck list
get banlist status for a card
list cards in a set or archetype
search cards by type, attribute, or ATK/DEF filters
